summary:
Empirical Playwright verification (desktop 1280x900, fullscreen Format editor) of the FloatingRichTextToolbar INLINE keydown fix (L2049-2101) that resolves the active cell via window.getSelection().getRangeAt(0).startContainer instead of e.target. ALL five Step-B critical scenarios that FAILED in iteration_117 now PASS: Enter from CENTER / LEFT / RIGHT cells each exit the row cleanly (row preserved at exactly 3 cells, a fresh empty

is inserted immediately after the row, caret parks in that

, and the cell texts are intact); Backspace at offset 0 of the empty Right cell is suppressed (row still 3 cells, Right cell retains contenteditable='true'); Backspace at offset 0 of a non-empty Left cell containing 'ab' is suppressed ('ab' intact, row intact). Regression scenarios also pass: INLINE insertion via AlignPanel inserts a .ir-irow with 3 cells, caret parks in left cell, display:flex with equal 273px cells; floating-rte-align-center/-right navigate the caret between cells without creating new rows; BLOCK mode toggle correctly applies 'ir-align-center' to an outer

without touching the row; persistence round-trip (close fullscreen -> reopen -> back to Format mode) retains querySelectorAll('[data-ir="irow"]').length === 1 with 3 cells all contenteditable='true'. One minor regression observed: pressing Ctrl+B then typing 'B' inside the Left cell produced plain 'B' (no wrapper), whereas iteration_117 recorded B. Flagging as low-priority since the toolbar Bold button was not re-tested in this run and prior iteration confirmed it works.

Possible cause: Ctrl+B was dispatched while the Selection anchor was mid-range of a ZWSP text node, or the format listener did not receive it because focus was Selection-only not DOM-focus. iteration_117 reported the toolbar Bold button working; the keyboard shortcut path may have a separate issue. Please re-verify with the toolbar Bold button (floating-rte-btn-bold) before treating as a regression.

action_items: LOW: Re-verify Bold-inside-INLINE-cell via BOTH the floating-rte-btn-bold toolbar click AND the Ctrl+B keyboard shortcut. iteration_119 saw the Ctrl+B keyboard shortcut produce plain 'B' (no <strong>). If the toolbar button path also fails, the inline bold path may need a selection-aware guard similar to the Enter/Backspace fix.
critical_code_review_comments: The INLINE keydown fix at FloatingRichTextToolbar.jsx L2049-2101 is correctly implemented: it resolves the active cell from window.getSelection().getRangeAt(0).startContainer and gates on ed.contains(range.startContainer). This fully resolves both Enter and Backspace regressions.

Audit opportunity: grep the file for any remaining `e.target` reads inside keyboard/clipboard handlers that are meant to scope to the INLINE cell. The caret cell must always be resolved from the Selection, since e.target in a nested contenteditable tree is almost always the outer editor root.
FloatingRichTextToolbar.jsx is still ~4276 lines. Extracting AlignPanel, HighlightPanel, AppearancePanel, and the INLINE row helpers into their own modules remains overdue.

success_rate.frontend: 10/11 scenarios PASS (90.9%). Both critical Step-B regressions (Enter exit, Backspace protect) PASS. One low-priority Bold-via-Ctrl+B anomaly flagged for retest with toolbar button.

seed_data_creation: Created 2 ephemeral notes: 'IR_StepB_Test' (keydown scenarios) and 'IR_Persist_Test' (regression + persistence). All seeding of ir-irow HTML was done via page.evaluate() setting editor.innerHTML and dispatching an 'input' event, matching the plan in the review_request.

rca_of_the_issue:
The two Step-B failures from iteration_117 (Enter not exiting the row, Backspace not protecting the empty cell) were caused by findInlineCell(ed, e.target) returning null because e.target for keydown events in a nested contenteditable tree is the OUTER editor
. The applied fix resolves the active cell from window.getSelection().getRangeAt(0).startContainer and gates on ed.contains(range.startContainer). Empirical verification in this iteration confirms the handler now fires preventDefault() correctly in all five scenarios (Enter from left/center/right, Backspace on empty cell, Backspace at offset 0 of non-empty cell), the row scaffold is preserved at exactly 3 cells, a fresh

is injected after the row on Enter, caret parks in that

, and the row survives save/close/reopen through the sanitizer.
